reason: Several procedural issues in the prefix raise modest failure risk. The agent's last assistant message issued 12 tool calls simultaneously, violating the policy's 'only make one tool call at a time' rule. It also assumed 'West Coast' maps to SFO/LAX/SEA/PHX/LAS/DEN without confirming with the user, and it has not yet searched return flights (May 25), asked about passenger details/baggage/insurance, or obtained the required explicit confirmation before booking. The failed cancellation earlier was correct per policy (no insurance, >24h, economy), so that is not itself a failure. The final outcome hinges on whether the agent converges on a valid round trip with user confirmation; nothing yet guarantees failure, but the multi-call violation and unconfirmed destination assumptions create elevated risk.
